## Review checklist

- [ ] The PR title follows Conventional Commits, for example `fix(hero): prevent mobile overflow`.
- [ ] The change is focused and links its issue with `Closes #…` when applicable.
- [ ] Public claims describe current, verifiable behavior.
- [ ] Keyboard, focus, responsive, and reduced-motion behavior were checked when affected.
- [ ] New dependencies and material tradeoffs are explained.
- [ ] Commits include a DCO sign-off (`git commit -s`).
